title: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
creator: Neutral Milk Hotel
summary: Jeff Mangum's surreal, grief-drenched masterpiece. One of the most beloved albums of its era.
personalNote: I resisted this album for years because of how much people talked about it. Then one night it made complete sense. The rawness isn't affectation — Mangum sounds like he has no choice but to mean every word. Two-Headed Boy Pt. 2 is the most heartbreaking song I know. I return to it when I want to feel something.
